text:
Sam L: Quick thought—let's pilot a tiny pop-up recognition kiosk next Wednesday during lunch (11:30–1:30). small cards + stickers + a QR to nominate someone on the spot.
Ava (People Ops): Love it. Doable. We have budget for ~75 kits. Which lobby are we thinking?
Maria P: I can handle printing the cards and stickers. Need vendor lead time—2 days if we use internal print, 4 days for external.
Jamal R: I can run volunteer shifts for setup/takedown. Suggest we do two 30min windows for peak foot traffic.
Tina D: Happy to help set up and staff. I can bring the tablet for the QR form.
Priya S: I can make a quick Google Sheet to track distribution counts and nominations.
Sam L: Great. I'm thinking main kitchen lobby—highest footfall. Poster copy short: "Spot a teammate spark? Leave a note. Give a sticker."
Ava (People Ops): Nice copy. Also want a one-line manager nudge email so managers encourage nominations. Sam, can you draft?
Sam L: Will draft manager note and a short poster. Poster will include QR (link shortener), 3 bullets: how to nominate, what winners get, raffle rules.
Maria P: Quick Q—are we offering a raffle? If yes, need prize approval.
Ava (People Ops): Yes let's do a $100 gift card raffle. I'll confirm with finance and add simple rules (one raffle ticket per nomination received that day).
FinanceBot: PO/expense check queued: ticket #45321. Awaiting approval from @finance.eta ~1 business day.
Jamal R: Volunteer roster: Jamal (11:00–12:00 setup), Tina (11:15–13:00), Priya (12:30–13:30 takedown). Need one more for 11:30–12:30.
Sam L: I can cover 11:30–12:30.
Priya S: Sheet created: https://docs.google.com/sheet/d/placeholder — will add columns: time, volunteer, kits dispensed, nominations link count.
Ava (People Ops): Perfect. Maria, order 75 kits (cards + stickers + small envelope). Use internal print if timeline tight.
Maria P: Ordering now. Using internal print for 2-day turnaround.
Sam L: Poster draft pasted below for feedback:
```
Spot a Spark?
See someone go above and beyond? Drop a note at the kiosk or scan the QR to nominate.
Winners get public shoutouts + raffle entry for a $100 gift card.
```
Ava (People Ops): Clean. Change "public shoutouts" to "team shoutouts". Also add small line: "Kiosk open 11:30–1:30 Wed 3/10"
Sam L: Updated poster copy.
Jamal R: One operational ask—can we pre-print a sheet of 10 stickers per kit so distribution is fast?
Maria P: Yep, will include sticker sheets.
Ava (People Ops): I'll send the manager nudge by EOD Monday and the volunteer runbook by EOD Tuesday. Sam—drop final poster + runbook in this thread when ready.
Sam L: Will do. Runbook will include setup checklist, QR link, volunteer schedule, and contact list.
KudosBot: Reminder queued: send manager nudge 24 hours before event.
Ava (People Ops): Thanks team! Excited to pilot. :tada: If anything blocks, flag in thread and ping me directly.
Sam L: Noted—I'll upload assets tonight.
Priya S: I'll bring a spare tablet charger and extension cable.
Tina D: Bringing a small sign holder and scissors.
Ava (People Ops): Amazing—closing checklist: PO submitted, poster + QR, volunteers confirmed, kits printed. We'll reconvene here Monday morning for final sweep. :white_check_mark:
